# zfs

## Files

- default.nix
- replication.nix

## File Summaries

### default.nix
NixOS module for ZFS filesystem support, enables ZFS and configures environment for selected hosts.

### replication.nix
ZFS Replication Module using Syncoid  Supports multiple independent replication jobs, each targeting a different pool on the remote host. Pool names are remapped automatically: source: zpool-xsvr1-main/systembackups target: zpool-xsvr2/systembackups  (sourcePool replaced by job.targetPool)  Source host: configure services.zfsReplication.jobs Target host: configure services.zfsReplication.sshPublicKey

## Overview

This folder contains the following files with their respective purposes summarized above.
